summary: Paint/Finish Visualizer (Decor8 AI) tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest passing — auth gating (401/403), validation (400 missing color for wall/cabinet, 400 missing image), live Decor8 render with public room URL returns {result_url, credits, cost} with cost=0 on first render and credits unchanged, history endpoint returns persisted item, 402 fires when credits=0 (verified by zeroing credits in Mongo). Exactly 1 live Decor8 render call made (~$0.20). Frontend: /paint-studio renders correctly via mobile viewport; all 4 feature chips (testIDs feat-wall/exterior/cabinet/flooring) switch correctly; Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, and Behr palettes all render with color-{hex} testIDs; custom hex input present (hex-input); Flooring mode swaps to finish-{hex} swatches and hides palette colors; ROOM TYPE chips appear only for Walls; render-btn (VISUALIZE IT) renders. Home banner home-paint-studio and hamburger AppMenu menu-paint-studio both navigate to /paint-studio. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2676 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth, projects, billing, visualizer, admin, community, etc.). Not a blocker for this feature but worth flagging for future maintainability.

On /api/visualize, the credits debit (`new_credits = user.get('credits',0) - cost`) reads the user dict captured at request start; if two requests race for the same user there is a small TOCTOU window. Low risk since each call is ~5-10s and gated by Decor8 latency, but a Mongo `$inc` with a credits-balance precondition would be safer.
Visualize 422 path returns generic message 'That photo or color didn\'t work' which is good UX, but logs only first 300 chars of Decor8 body — fine for now.

paint-studio.tsx: the `render` useCallback dependency array omits `color` (uses `color?.hex` inside). Minor — state value is captured fresh on each render anyway since useCallback re-creates, but ESLint exhaustive-deps would flag it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI elements + both nav entry points verified)

seed_data_creation: Test creates one fresh user TEST_paint_{ts}@diyhomie.com, makes 1 live Decor8 render, then teardown deletes the user and their visualizations from Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_paint_visualizer.py makes exactly ONE live Decor8 call (~$0.20). Auth/validation/402 paths short-circuit before any Decor8 HTTP request, so re-running them is free. To rerun: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://step-by-step-diy.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=diyhomie pytest backend/tests/test_paint_visualizer.py -v`. The fresh-user fixture is module-scoped so cost=0 invariant holds. Frontend testIDs: feat-{wall,exterior,cabinet,flooring}, pick-{gallery,camera}, color-{hex}, finish-{hex}, hex-input, render-btn, compare-toggle, home-paint-studio, menu-paint-studio.
